articles.summary: The LiteLLM supply chain attack exfiltrated SSH keys, cloud credentials, and Kubernetes secrets from every machine that installed the compromised package. What happened, why it matters, and what to do about it.
articles.title: Your AI toolchain is now an attack surface

articles.summary: Code review results come back as dashboard views and PR comments that agents can't parse. The DeepSource CLI gives them structured JSON — issues by file, Report Card grades, CVSS-scored vulnerabilities — so they can iterate with targeted fixes instead of guessing.
articles.title: Code review for AI agents

articles.summary: DeepSource now supports BYOK for AI Review on Enterprise Server. Bring your own API keys from Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or Google Gemini through your existing cloud provider.
articles.title: BYOK for AI Review
